reviewed_by: Codex focused dependency review for anyio 4.14.2
reason: anyio underlies httpx async provider and MCP HTTP operations. Three exact cases cover a provider HTTP request, an MCP HTTP tool response, and timeout recovery with the updated lockfile installed in clean CI. poetry check --lock passed locally.
exclusions: No frontend or native dependency changed, so those layers and Playwright are excluded. The selected mocked/local HTTP cases do not reproduce the TLS hostname vulnerability or prove live external-provider behavior. Unrelated Python and full suites are excluded; local collection is blocked by the host pyOpenSSL and cryptography mismatch.
